front: When did Hitler Youth membership become compulsory?
back: 1939 (the 1936 law made it the state youth organisation).
Working-class young people who rejected the Hitler Youth; some helped deserters in the war.

front: Why did unemployment fall so sharply after 1933?
back: Public works, the Labour Service, conscription, rearmament, and leaving women and Jews out of the figures.

front: Why did Nazi policy on women change?
back: From 1937 rearmament caused labour shortages, so women were needed in work.
